title.narrative: AfricaConnect 3 - Cluster 2 (Western and Central Africa)

description.narrative: AfricaConnect 3 will contribute to enhance human capital development in Africa (Overall Objective). More specifically, it will seek to unlock the potential of education and research through increased access of African education and research institutions to digital infrastructures and technologies (Specific Objective). This contract will cover the activities in West and Central Africa (Cluster 2 of the project)
